skill.name: serp-analysis
skill.description: Use when the user asks to analyze a search results page for a keyword. Maps SERP features, search intent, ranking patterns, AI Overview opportunities, and true difficulty from live or provided evidence.
skill.summary: Analyze SERP features, intent, ranking patterns, and difficulty for SEO planning.
skill.author: aaron-he-zhu

security_audit.summary: Most static findings are false positives from Markdown fences, relative repository links, metadata URLs, and inline path templates. Two medium findings are confirmed because the skill instructs agents to run bundled Python connector commands for live SERP data; no prompt injection, secret exfiltration, or arbitrary path traversal evidence was found.

remediation.issue: Shell connector commands are embedded in the skill instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Require explicit user approval before running connector commands, keep keyword arguments quoted, and document that live network calls may occur.

remediation.issue: Allowed tool metadata does not clearly describe shell connector usage.
remediation.suggestion: Align the declared tool requirements with the documented connector workflow or provide host-native alternatives for environments without shell access.

remediation.issue: The saved report path uses a topic placeholder.
remediation.suggestion: State that the topic should be converted to a safe slug before writing the memory file.

content.value_statement: SERP research often misses search intent, feature pressure, and the real content bar. This skill turns live or provided search results into a concise brief for ranking strategy, AI visibility, and content planning.
actual_capabilities: Maps SERP features such as AI Overviews, featured snippets, People Also Ask, video packs, local packs, and shopping results.
Compares top ranking pages by format, freshness, authority signals, backlinks, and visible on-page patterns.
Classifies dominant search intent with evidence from live results, screenshots, or supplied top ranking URLs.
Calculates a True Difficulty score using weighted inputs for authority, links, content quality, backlink needs, and SERP stability.
Produces recommendations for content requirements, feature targeting, outlines, and next SEO actions.
Labels metrics as measured, user-provided, estimated, or unavailable to prevent unsupported claims.
limitations: It does not replace dedicated keyword demand discovery or search volume research.
Feature composition still needs a live SERP screenshot or manual review when connectors return only organic results.
Authority, backlink, and freshness metrics depend on available tools or user-provided exports.
Historical SERP change analysis requires prior snapshots, third-party data, or user-provided evidence.

use_cases.title: Assess Competitive Difficulty

use_cases.title: Prioritize AI Visibility Work

prompt_templates.title: Analyze One Keyword
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner analysis for a single search query.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze the SERP for "[keyword]" in [country or city] on [desktop or mobile]. Use the provided URLs or screenshot if live results are unavailable.

prompt_templates.title: Find Ranking Requirements
prompt_templates.scenario: Content planning after choosing a target keyword.
prompt_templates.prompt: Review the top results for "[keyword]" and tell me what content format, depth, freshness, authority, and SERP features I need to compete.

prompt_templates.title: Compare Query Variants
prompt_templates.prompt: Compare SERPs for "[keyword 1]", "[keyword 2]", and "[keyword 3]". Identify intent differences, shared competitors, feature opportunities, and the best first target.

prompt_templates.title: Build an Advanced SERP Strategy
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced planning with AI visibility and site-stage fit.
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze "[keyword]" using live or supplied SERP evidence. Include feature composition, top-result patterns, AI Overview citation opportunities, True Difficulty, site-stage fit, and recommended next actions.

output_examples.input: Analyze the SERP for "how to start a podcast".
output_examples.output: A SERP brief that identifies informational intent, AI Overview presence, featured snippet format, top ranking guide patterns, difficulty score, content requirements, and long-tail alternatives.

output_examples.input: Compare "best CRM for startups" and "CRM software for small business".
output_examples.output: A comparison showing commercial intent differences, common ranking domains, review and comparison page patterns, likely snippet targets, and the query with the better entry point.

output_examples.input: Review this mobile SERP screenshot for a local service query.
output_examples.output: A feature map covering local pack placement, ads, organic listings, review signals, map visibility, local content gaps, and actions for Google Business Profile and page content.

best_practices: Provide target location, language, device, date, and any screenshots or top ranking URLs before analysis.
Separate measured tool data from estimates and mark unavailable metrics as N/A.
Use the findings to choose one primary SERP feature target and one realistic content path.
anti_patterns: Do not treat a keyword difficulty score as reliable without the evidence behind each input.
Do not assume AI Overview, PAA, ads, or local pack presence from organic result lists alone.
Do not use this skill for broad keyword discovery when the real task is demand research.

faq.question: What does this skill analyze?
faq.answer: It analyzes search result layout, intent, top ranking pages, SERP features, AI visibility opportunities, and ranking difficulty.

faq.question: Can it fetch live SERP data?
faq.answer: It can guide compatible hosts to use bundled keyless connectors, but some SERP features still need a screenshot or manual review.

faq.question: Does it perform keyword research?
faq.answer: No. It analyzes chosen queries. Use a keyword research workflow for volume, demand, and broad topic discovery.

faq.question: How does it calculate difficulty?
faq.answer: It uses weighted inputs for top ten authority, page authority, content quality, backlink needs, and SERP stability.

faq.question: Can it help with AI Overviews?
faq.answer: Yes. It reviews visible AI Overview patterns and recommends citation-friendly content structures when evidence is available.

faq.question: What should I provide for best results?
faq.answer: Provide the keyword, country or city, language, device, date, screenshots, top URLs, and any SEO tool exports you have.
